units.source_text: 夏去秋来，风声也越来越觉凄凉。

en.t: Summer passed and autumn came, and the sound of the wind felt more and more desolate.

units.source_text: 此时即须准备举办法事。

en.t: At this time, preparations had to be made at once for the memorial service.

units.source_text: 从八月初开始，大家忙碌起来。

en.t: From the beginning of the eighth month, everyone became busy.

units.source_text: 源氏回想过去，好容易挨过这些岁月，直到今日。

en.t: Genji looked back on the past, thinking how he had somehow endured these years up to this day.

units.source_text: 今后也只有茫茫然地度送晨昏。

en.t: From now on too, he could only pass the mornings and evenings in a daze.

units.source_text: 周年忌辰的正日，上下人等都吃素斋。

en.t: On the exact day of the first anniversary memorial, everyone high and low ate vegetarian fare.

units.source_text: 那曼陀罗图就在今日供养。

en.t: That mandala painting was to be dedicated in offering on this very day.
Genji performed his nightly devotions as usual.

units.source_text: 中将君送上水盆，请他洗手。

en.t: Lady Chujo brought him a basin of water and invited him to wash his hands.

units.source_text: 他看见她的扇子上题着一首诗，便取来看：

en.t: He noticed a poem written on her fan, so he took it up and looked at it:
